estimand: Per donor, RNA-defined T-cell mean of cellwise log1p raw ADT counts, Typhim Vi day 7 minus day 0; RNA and the eight anchor ADTs observed in both arms; all other ADTs hidden for calibration and test donors.
targets: All 122 prepared proteins outside the anchor panel; no outcome-based filtering

cellbridge.gene_selection_donors: training donors only (RNA only); cognate genes of all panel proteins forced in
cellbridge.selection: Leave-one-training-donor-out over the full grid; average of the best 5% of configurations by target-pooled standardized MAE; no calibration or test outcome is used

baselines.rna_ridge: pseudobulk response ridge on 2000 response-variance HVGs, alpha in {0.1,1,10,100,None} by inner LODO over all hidden targets
baselines.v040_abundance_shrinkage: ResponseBridge 0.4 estimator, nested alpha x shrinkage by inner LODO over all hidden targets
baselines.totalvi: scvi-tools TOTALVI, one prespecified fit (see totalvi block); query donors' non-anchor ADTs encoded as missing
baselines.v050_sealed: ResponseBridge 0.5 predictions sealed on 2026-10-07 before any outcome access; secondary only

totalvi.aggregation: mean log1p of imputed protein counts per arm, transform_batch = training donors

metric: Per donor standardized MAE (absolute error / training-donor response SD per protein), averaged over the endpoint's proteins, then over the 10 test donors
testing: Fixed-sequence (hierarchical) testing in the listed order; each hypothesis tested at two-sided alpha only if all previous nulls were rejected; exact sign-flip test on per-donor loss differences (2^10 patterns) and paired donor bootstrap 95% CI (10000). A hypothesis whose comparator could not be executed before the seal is removed without consuming alpha.
secondary: pooled split-conformal coverage from 9 calibration donors

variant_selection.rule: Lowest mean all-hidden standardized MAE over 9 development tasks (8 Lawlor arms + LODO within the 11 GSE334503 training donors), selection rule shared_top05 fixed before variants were compared

supersedes: The v0.5 freeze (runs/freeze_v050) and GSE334503 v0.5 seal are superseded before any GSE334503 calibration/test outcome access. v0.5 sealed predictions remain sealed secondary comparators.
amendment_before_unblinding: E2 (all hidden proteins) added as an endpoint ahead of the v0.4/v0.5 CD25/CD69-only endpoint; decided from development data only.
limitations: Single independent cohort with 10 test donors
Lawlor development outcomes were exposed in earlier versions
Vaccine day-7 change is not a causal vaccine effect
Predictions cannot recover target-only changes invisible to RNA and anchors
